readme:
# Douyin Recommended Insight Reports API

Access recommended Douyin trend insight reports from the home page. This endpoint requires no query parameters to retrieve current platform recommendations.

## Use cases

- Discover trending industry insights and research topics on Douyin.
- Monitor featured analytical reports highlighted on the platform home page.
- Automate regular retrieval of platform-curated trend highlights.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/index/insight-recommend" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Douyin Index Area List](/model/douyin/index/all-area): Returns the complete list of supported geographic areas available for Douyin Index queries.
- [Douyin Index Valid Dates](/model/douyin/index/all-valid-date): Returns the latest valid dates available for each data type in Douyin Index.
- [Douyin Brand Popularity Cycles](/model/douyin/index/brand-cycles): Returns periodic brand popularity and cycle analysis data across platforms for a specified brand name and date range.
